text: ἐκτρέφω, I nourish, nurture.
ἔκτρωμα, (strictly a lifeless abortion) an untimely birth.
ἐκφεύγω, I flee out, away, I escape: with an acc. I escape something.
gloss: I flee out, away, I escape

text: ἐκφοβέω, I terrify exceedingly.
ἔκφοβος, exceedingly afraid.
ἐκφύω, I put forth, cause to sprout.
gloss: I put forth, cause to sprout

text: ἐκχωρέω, I go out.
ἐκψύχω, I breathe my last, I die.
gloss: I breathe my last, I die

text: ἑκών, willing, willingly.
Ἐλαιών (oliuetum), Olive-grove, Olive-yard, probably the right text in Lk. xix 29, xxi 37, as well as Ac. i 12.
Ἐλαμείτης, an Elamite, one of a people living to the north of the Persian Gulf in the southern part of Persia.
ἐλάσσων (less correct ἐλάττων), less, smaller: poorer, inferior, John ii 10: ἔλαττον (adv.), less.
ἐλαττονέω, I have less, I lack.
ἐλαττόω, I make less (inferior).
ἐλαύνω, (a) tr. I drive (on), propel: (b) intr. I row, Mk. vi 48, John vi 19.
ἐλαφρία (leuitas), levity, fickleness.
ἐλαφρός (leuis), light.
Ἐλεάζαρ (Hebr.), Eleazar, son of Eliud, and father of Matthan.
gloss: Eleazar, son of Eliud, and father of Matthan

text: ἐλεγμός, reproof.
ἔλεγξις, rebuke, reproof.
ἔλεγχος, a proof: possibly a persuasion.
ἐλεεινός, merciful, pitiful.
ἐλεήμων, pitiful, merciful.
ἐλευθερόω, I free, set free, liberate.
ἔλευσις, coming, arrival.
ἐλεφάντινος, made of ivory.
Ἐλιακείμ (Hebr.), Eliakim, son of Abiud and father of Azor (Mt. i 13), son of Melea and father of Jonam (Lk. iii 30).
gloss: Eliakim, son of Abiud and father of Azor

text: Ἐλιέζερ (Hebr.), Eliezer, son of Joreim and father of Joshua.
gloss: Eliezer, son of Joreim and father of Joshua

text: Ἐλιούδ (Hebr.), Eliud, son of Acheim, and father of Eleazar.
gloss: Eliud, son of Acheim, and father of Eleazar

text: Ἑλισαῖος, Helisaeus, grecized form of Elisha.
ἑλίσσω, I roll, roll up.
ἑλκόομαι, I am covered with sores.
ἕλκος (ulcus), a (festering) sore.
ἕλκω, I drag, draw, pull.
Ἑλλάς, Hellas, the native name for Greece.
gloss: Hellas, the native name for Greece

text: Ἑλληνικός, Greek: ἡ Ἑλληνικὴ (γλῶσσα), the Greek language.
Ἑλληνίς (fem.), Greek; see Ἕλλην.
Ἑλληνιστής, a Hellenist, Grecian Jew, a Greek-speaking Jew, that is one who can speak Greek only and not Hebrew (or Aramaic).
gloss: a Hellenist, Grecian Jew, a Greek-speaking Jew

text: Ἑλληνιστί, in the Greek language.
ἐλλογάω (ἐλλογέω), I put down (set) to some one's account, reckon, impute.
gloss: I put down (set) to some one's account, reckon, impute
note: Headword printed ἐλλογάω with ἐλλογέω in brackets.

text: Ἐλμαδάμ (Hebr.), Elmadam, father of Kosam, son of Er.
gloss: Elmadam, father of Kosam, son of Er

text: Ἐλύμας, Elymas, the name of the sorcerer at Paphos (the form of the name is doubtful: some MSS read Ἑτοιμᾶς, Son of the Ready).
gloss: Elymas, the name of the sorcerer at Paphos

text: ἐλωί (Aramaic), my God (form of word is doubtful).
ἐμβάλλω, I cast in, throw in.
ἐμβάπτω, act. and mid. I dip in.

ἐμβατεύω, (I enter on, take possession of, hence) technical expression connected with the pagan Mysteries, I enter, set foot on (the inner shrine, after the first initiation). It indicates the final act in mystic ceremonial, the entrance on a new life in presence of the god.
ἐμβιβάζω, tr. I embark, put on board.

ἐμβριμάομαι, I groan (with the notion of coercion springing out of displeasure, anger, indignation, antagonism), I express indignant displeasure, with dat. of person with whom it is felt, Mt. ix 30, Mk. i 43, xiv 5: absol. John xi 33, 38.
ἐμέω, I vomit.
ἐμμαίνομαι, I am madly enraged with.
Ἐμμανουήλ (Hebr.), Emmanuel, a Messianic title derived from Isa. vii 14 = God with us.
Ἐμμαούς, Emmaus (Ammaus), a village not far from Jerusalem.
gloss: Emmaus (Ammaus), a village not far from Jerusalem

text: ἐμμένω, I remain (abide) in, Ac. xxviii 30: hence met. Heb. viii 9: with plain dative, I abide by, maintain, Ac. xiv 22, Gal. iii 10.
Ἐμμώρ (Hebr.), Emmor, Hamor, a man whose sons sold a field at Shechem to Jacob.
note: Breathing on the headword is faint on the image; read as smooth (Ἐ), could be rough (Ἑ). | approved by David, 2026-11-09

text: ἐμπαιγμονή, mockery.
ἐμπαιγμός, mockery.
ἐμπαίκτης, a mocker.
ἐμπλέκω, I enfold, entangle.
ἐμπλοκή, braiding.
ἐμπορεύομαι, I travel as a merchant, engage in trade: c. acc. I traffic in, make gain or business of.
gloss: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade

text: ἐμπορία, trading, trade, trafficking, business.
ἐμπόριον, a place of traffic, mart, market, market-house.
gloss: a place of traffic, mart, market, market-house

text: ἐμπτύω, I spit upon.
ἐμφανής, manifest, visible.
ἔμφοβος, full of fear, terrified.
ἐμφυσάω, I breathe into, breathe upon.
ἔμφυτος, inborn, ingrown, congenital, natural.
ἐναγκαλίζομαι, I take (fold) in my arms.
ἐνάλιος (rather a poetical word), of creatures, living in the sea.
ἔναντι, before, in the presence of.
ἐναντίον, before, in the presence of; in the eyes of: see also τοὐναντίον.
ἐναντίος, opposite, opposed, contrary: ἐξ ἐναντίας (adv.), opposite; ὁ ἐξ ἐναντίας, the adversary.
ἐνάρχομαι, I begin (in).
ἐνδεής, in need, needy.
ἔνδειγμα, (a thing proved, hence) a plain token (sign, proof).
ἔνδειξις, a showing, proof, demonstration.
ἕνδεκα, eleven.
ἑνδέκατος, eleventh.
ἐνδέχομαι, ἐνδέχεται, impers., it is possible.
ἐνδημέω, I am in my δῆμος (parish), I am at home.
gloss: I am in my δῆμος (parish), I am at home

text: ἐνδιδύσκω, (somewhat rare) (of clothing, I put on another): mid. I put on (myself).
ἔνδικος, just.
ἐνδοξάζω (I make ἔνδοξος), I glorify, acknowledge the glory belonging to (cf. δόξα), recognize as glorious.
gloss: I glorify, acknowledge the glory belonging to

text: ἔνδοξος, glorious.
ἔνδυμα, a garment, dress.
ἐνδύνω, I enter into.
ἔνδυσις, putting on (of a garment).
ἐνδώμησις, roofing, coping. (So probably, from δῶμα = roof, but most interpret building.)
ἐνέδρα (insidiae), ambuscade; hence plot, treachery, fraud.
ἐνεδρεύω, I lie in wait (ambush) for, seek to entrap (hence I defraud, deceive).
gloss: I lie in wait (ambush) for, seek to entrap

text: ἐνειλέω, I wrap up, roll up in (something).
gloss: I wrap up, roll up in (something)

text: ἔνειμι, I am in (within): τὰ ἐνόντα, probably the contents (of the dish), or perhaps what you can, but the words are obscure and may be a mistranslation of an Aramaic original.
ἐνενήκοντα, ninety.
ἐνεός (= ἄνεως), speechless, dumb, unable to speak.
ἐνέργεια, working, action productive of ἔργον (concrete work), activity: in the N.T. confined to superhuman activity.
gloss: working, action productive of ἔργον (concrete work)

text: ἐνέργημα, a working.
ἐνεργής, effective, productive of due result.
ἐνευλογέω, I bless (of God) (ἐν is considered to have instrumental force).

ἐνέχω, (a) I have a grudge against, I am angry (with): in Mk. vi 19 the Sahidic translates ‘I am angry with’, the Vulgate ‘insidior’; in Lk. xi 53 δεινῶς ἐνέχειν is translated by the Sahidic ‘to provoke him’, by the Vulgate ‘grauiter insistere’; (b) pass. or mid. I am entangled, entangle myself (in 2 Thess. i 4 text doubtful).
gloss: I have a grudge against, I am angry (with)

text: ἐνέχω, (a) I have a grudge against, I am angry (with): in Mk. vi 19 the Sahidic translates ‘I am angry with’, the Vulgate ‘insidior’; in Lk. xi 53 δεινῶς ἐνέχειν is translated by the Sahidic ‘to provoke him’, by the Vulgate ‘grauiter insistere’; (b) pass. or mid. I am entangled, entangle myself (in 2 Thess. i 4 text doubtful).
gloss: I have a grudge against, I am angry (with)

text: ἐνθάδε, here, in this place.
ἔνθεν, hence, from this place.
ἐνθυμέομαι, I meditate upon, reflect upon.
ἐνθύμησις, inward thought, meditation; plur. thoughts.
ἔνι (ἐνί, Ionic form of ἐν), is in (among): οὐκ ἔνι, there is (or can be) no room for.
ἐνισχύω, I strengthen within, I fill with strength.
gloss: I strengthen within, I fill with strength

text: ἐνκάθετος, a snare-setter, spy.
ἐνκαίνια, festival of dedication of the Temple, to celebrate the re-dedication of the Temple by Judas Maccabeus in 164 B.C., held at Jerusalem about the middle of December.
ἐνκαινίζω, (I restore or carry out anew, then) I dedicate.
ἐνκακέω, ἐκκακέω (from κακός in the sense of cowardly) (very rare outside the Bible), I lose heart.
ἐνκατοικέω, I am settled among, dwell among.
gloss: I am settled among, dwell among

text: ἐνκαυχάομαι, I boast in (because of) something.
ἐνκεντρίζω, I graft.
ἐνκοπή, ἐκκοπή, obstacle, check, hindrance.
ἐνκρίνω, I judge (reckon) to belong to, I class with.
gloss: I judge (reckon) to belong to, I class with

text: ἔνκυος, pregnant.
ἐννέα, nine.
ἐννεύω, I make a sign to by nodding.
gloss: I make a sign to by nodding

text: ἔννοια (intelligence, thought), intention, purpose.
ἔννομος, (a) legal, statutory, duly constituted, Ac. xix 39; (b) under the law, obedient to the law, 1 Cor. ix 21.
ἔννυχα, in the night.
ἐνορκίζω (a strengthened ὁρκίζω), c. dupl. acc. I adjure some one by, I solemnly appeal to some one by.
ἑνότης, oneness, unity.
ἐνοχλέω, I disturb, torment (Heb. xii 15 is from the LXX, where ἐνοχλῇ appears to be a corruption for ἐν χολῇ, in gall).
ἐνπεριπατέω, I walk among.
ἐνπνέω (lit. I breathe in), I breathe of, breathe.
ἔνταλμα, an injunction, ordinance.
ἐνταφιάζω, I embalm, prepare for burial.
ἐνταφιασμός, embalming, preparation of corpse for burial.
gloss: embalming, preparation of corpse for burial

text: ἔντευξις (lit. approaching the king, hence a technical term), a petition.
ἐντόπιος, belonging to the place, native, resident.
gloss: belonging to the place, native, resident

text: ἐντός, within, inside (so also Lk. xvii 21); τὸ ἐντός, the inside.
ἐντρέπω, (a) I turn to confusion, put to shame, e.g. 1 Cor. iv 14, 2 Thess. iii 14, Tit. ii 8; (b) mid. c. acc., meaning I reverence, e. g. Mk. xii 6, Heb. xii 9.
gloss: I turn to confusion, put to shame

text: ἐντρέφω, I nourish (sustain) on.
ἔντρομος, trembling.
ἐντροπή (from ἐντρέπω), shame.
ἐντρυφάω, I revel (in).
ἐντυγχάνω, (a) I meet, encounter; hence, (b) I call (upon), I make a petition, I make suit, supplication, cf. ἔντευξις.
ἐντυλίσσω, I wrap up, roll round, envelop.
gloss: I wrap up, roll round, envelop

text: ἐντυπόω, I engrave.
ἐνυβρίζω, I insult, outrage.
ἐνυπνιάζομαι, I dream (see visions) in my sleep.
gloss: I dream (see visions) in my sleep

text: ἐνύπνιον, a dream, vision.
Ἐνώς (Hebr.), Enos, son of Seth, and father of Cainam.
gloss: Enos, son of Seth, and father of Cainam

text: ἐνωτίζομαι (from ἐν and οὖς), I take into my ear, give ear to.
gloss: I take into my ear, give ear to

text: Ἐνώχ, Ἐνώκ (Hebr.), Enoch, son of Jaret and father of Mathusala: Jude 14 refers to the apocryphal Book of Enoch.
gloss: Enoch, son of Jaret and father of Mathusala

text: ἐξαγγέλλω, I announce publicly, proclaim.
ἐξαγοράζω, I buy out, buy away from, ransom: mid. I purchase out, buy, redeem.
gloss: I buy out, buy away from, ransom

text: ἐξαιρέω, I take out, remove; sometimes (mid.) I choose, sometimes I rescue.
ἐξαίρω, I remove.
ἐξαιτέομαι, I beg earnestly for: aor. = I have procured to be given up to me (Field).
ἐξαίφνης (ἐξέφνης, colloquially), suddenly.
ἐξακολουθέω, I follow closely, adhere to.
ἑξακόσιοι, six hundred.
ἐξαλείφω, I wipe away, obliterate.
ἐξάλλομαι, I leap up (for joy).
ἐξανάστασις, rising up and out, resurrection.
ἐξανατέλλω, I rise (spring) up out (of the ground).
gloss: I rise (spring) up out (of the ground)

text: ἐξανίστημι, (a) in tr. tenses, I raise up, cause to grow; (b) in intr. tenses, I rise up.
gloss: I raise up, cause to grow

text: ἐξαπατάω, I deceive.
ἐξάπινα, suddenly.
ἐξαπορέομαι, I am at my wits' end, I despair: c. gen. about, 2 Cor. i 8.
gloss: I am at my wits' end, I despair
